source.text: FINDINGS: Frontal and lateral views of the chest show normal size and configuration of the cardiac silhouette.
FINDINGS: There is aortic XXXX vascular calcification.
FINDINGS: And there is a hyper left lung calcified granuloma.
FINDINGS: Normal mediastinal contour, pulmonary XXXX and vasculature, central airways and lung volumes.
FINDINGS: There are vascular and skeletal senescent changes.
IMPRESSION: No acute or active cardiac, pulmonary or pleural disease.

changes.description: The original report stated 'No pleural effusion.' This was changed to 'There is a small pleural effusion,' which is a fabrication as no pleural effusion is visible in the provided images.

rationale: The change introduces a fabrication by stating the presence of a small pleural effusion when the images clearly show no such finding. This is a clinically plausible error that contradicts the visual evidence.
